description: Hand-authored synthetic contrast fixtures for local release qualification. These are engineering scenarios, not a representative accuracy benchmark. Boundary candidates are unlabelled and are not claimed to produce probabilities near 0.5 until measured on a pinned checkpoint.
label_policy: Expected values follow the explicit question rubric. Choice labels are category names, noul labels are booleans and score labels are zero-based ordinal levels. Empty expected maps intentionally exclude ambiguous boundary candidates from labelled quality metrics. Related variants always share one source family and one split.
